text:
alex: FYI AcmeRetail (acct AC-9876) opened an escalation — their dashboard shows 1,240,812 tokens for Feb but the final invoice shows 1,124,321 and they were bumped to 'pro' tier on the invoice. Customer says dashboard never showed pro. Invoice INV-2026-02-999 attached. Anyone seen a re-attribution/backfill that could cause line-item reassignment?

maya: Can you drop acct id + invoice id and a quick screenshot? Also did they call the migration API last week?

alex: acct AC-9876, invoice INV-2026-02-999. They ran a plan migration on 2026-02-26 22:14:03 via `/v1/subscriptions/migrate`. Screenshot: (omitted). CSV snippet for suspect rows:

```
date,source,tokens,line
2026-02-26,api,120000,growth
2026-02-27,backfill,120000,pro
```

pranav: Running a meter query now — can someone run:

```
SELECT account_id, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM meter_events
WHERE account_id = 'AC-9876'
  AND ts >= '2026-02-01' AND ts < '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY 1;
```

pranav: quick update: I see a backfill job `backfill-reprocess-2026-03-01` completed at 2026-03-01T01:03:45Z that re-attributed ~116,491 tokens to alias mapping `pro_alias_v2`. That aligns with the invoice delta.

jordan: Billing note — we ran a late ingest correction that reprocessed Feb events on 2026-03-01; invoices are generated from the ledger (post-backfill). Dashboards snapshot at 00:00 UTC on the last day of month so they missed the correction. That explains the mismatch and the tier bump. Options: (1) re-issue invoice (needs ops/legal signoff), (2) issue credit for the difference, (3) update dashboard snapshot to include backfill history. My preference: credit and flag product to change dashboard snapshot policy.

zoe: We can run a resync for the dashboard for a single account: `python tools/resync_billing.py --account AC-9876 --asof 2026-03-01` — this will update dashboard-only snapshot without touching invoices. ETA ~10m.

jordan: Sounds good. Billing will compute credit. Estimated credit = (1,240,812 - 1,124,321) * rate_per_token. @maya can you confirm the Feb blended rate and draft a credit memo?

maya: On it. Feb blended rate is $0.00025/token (growth/pro blended) per Feb pricing sheet. Drafting memo and sharing with billing for approval, will loop CS to inform customer. :eyes:

alex: Thanks all. Owners: @maya (CS/billing contact), @jordan (billing), @zoe (ops). I'll send AcmeRetail an interim note that we're investigating and will credit if needed. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: backfill-reprocess-2026-03-01 finished | reprocessed 116491 events | affected_accounts: [AC-9876] :white_check_mark:
